message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (dates that fall on a weekday will give you an extra day off, creating a three‑day weekend).  
(If a holiday falls on a Saturday or Sunday, the “observed” date is usually the following Monday.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Observed (if applicable) |
|---------|-------------|-------------|--------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sun | – |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 | Mon | – |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Fri | – |
| Easter Monday (Federal employees only) | Apr 10 | Mon | – |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Mon | – |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Sat | Jul 3 (Mon) |
| Civic Holiday (Ontario, British Columbia, etc.) | Aug 7 | Mon | – |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Mon | – |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 | Mon | – |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Wed | – |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Mon | – |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tue | – |

**Long‑weekends (three‑day weekends)**  
- **Family Day** (Feb 20–22) – Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario  
- **Good Friday** (Apr 7–9) – all provinces (plus Easter Monday for federal workers)  
- **Victoria Day** (May 22–24) – all provinces  
- **Canada Day** (Jul 1–3) – all provinces (observed Jul 3)  
- **Civic Holiday** (Aug 7–9) – Ontario, BC, etc.  
- **Labour Day** (Sep 4–6) – all provinces  
- **Thanksgiving** (Oct 9–11) – all provinces  
- **Remembrance Day** (Nov 11–13) – all provinces (observed if it falls on a weekend)  
- **Christmas & Boxing Day** (Dec 25–27) – all provinces  

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app!
